cr_data.provenance: (An American Place, New York, NY); Mr. and Mrs. Maurice Wertheim, New York, NY, 1930s; (The Downtown Gallery, New York, NY); The artist, 1962; (Doris Bry, New York, NY); Private collection, New York, NY, 1972; (Doris Bry, New York, NY); The artist, by exchange, 1972; (Doris Bry, New York, NY); The Davis Family Foundation, New Orleans, Louisiana, 1974; Sotheby's, New York, NY, sale no. 6305, lot no. 102, 27 May 1992; Gerald Peters Gallery, Santa Fe, New Mexico, and Mongerson Wunderlich, Chicago, Illinois, 1992; Greenberg Van Doren Gallery, St. Louis, Missouri, 1992 (Source: Lynes, 1999)
remarks_1999: Double entries Downtown Gallery Archive. Whitney Archive indicates, "Probably painted 1931. Sold to Maurice Wertheim's second wife who exchanged it for another picture. Miss O'Keeffe does not know where it is now." Whitney Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks indicate, "The last calla painted." Exchanged in 1972 for cat. no. 962. Whitney Archive dates 1931? Downtown Gallery Archive dates 1930 and 1931. Abiquiú Notebooks dates 1930/1931. Dated 1930 on basis of verso inscription. (Source: Lynes, 1999)

titles.notes: Source of title: Whitney Archive, Downtown Gallery Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks.
titles.title: Calla Lilies

description: Soft, white calla lilies cover the canvas. In the lower right corner, two small green stems emerge from the clusters.
title: Calla Lilies
